conventions.artboard: 268x580 design px (iPhone 6.9in). x/y/w are fractions of 268; y/h are fractions of 580.
conventions.device: x,y = device centre; y>1 or x outside 0..1 = bleed. scale = device width / 176 px (1.0 = .657W). iPhone height = 369.75*scale px (aspect .476); frame 'none' = frameless card, height = 380.95*scale (aspect .462). 'second' = back/peeking device.
conventions.pose: CSS conventions: tiltX = rotateX (pitch, + tips top away), tiltY = rotateY (yaw; negative turns the screen toward the left, i.e. a phone on the right faces centre), roll = rotateZ (+ clockwise).
conventions.caption: captionY = top of the headline block (fraction of 580); captionSize = headline font size as a fraction of 268 (e.g. .13 = 34.8px). eyebrow sits ~.03 above captionY. captionPos 'left' = a column x .075-.46 beside the device. Optional per-frame 'ink'/'accent' override the template values (dark/inverted frames).
conventions.accent: One *starred* run per caption. accentStyle: color = run in accent; highlight = accent-filled marker/pill behind the run with ink text; italic = serif italic swap in accent; underline = run in accent with an accent underline.
conventions.decor: x,y = centre, w,h = size (fractions). number = large display text (stats, numerals, Monolith's word) in color; shape = rect (rules, mats, dimension lines); chip = rounded label; badge = small text label; laurel/stars = rating proof (Apple only); zoom = magnified screen crop card with an accent ring.
conventions.backgrounds: Browser-renderable CSS approximations for mockups. Conic wedges stand in for Ridgeline's ridge paths; the product draws real paths.
